# Winter Clothing Canada

A single-page winter shopfront for real Canadian cold: 50 products from Mountain Warehouse (25) and Columbia (25) — parkas and boots — with CAD prices checked live on the retailers' own sites on November 5, 2026, a live price tracker and discount tracker, a product filter and search, a find-yours quiz, a cost-per-winter calculator, a comparison table, and compact detail sections with honest flaws.

- [Winter Clothing Canada](https://yorkdigitalagency.github.io/canada-winter-clothing/): The full shopfront — all 50 products, price tracker, discount table, quiz, calculator, comparison, and details.

Price tracker (checked November 5, 2026; re-checked daily): 50 products tracked, 28 on sale right now. Biggest saving: Mountain Warehouse Antarctic Extreme, 63% off — $340 off ($199.99, was $539.99). Every product shows the date its price was last checked and the lowest price we have seen; a re-check that finds a lower price adds a "Price dropped" badge. Prices range $49.99–$549.99 CAD. Prices change — the retailer's page is the final word.

This site sells nothing. Retailer links go to the retailers' own pages. No affiliate links are active yet; when added, they will be clearly marked. Product pictures are created images of similar products, not the actual product photos; pictures for the 44 newer products are being made to match each product, and 22 of 50 products have matched pictures so far. No hands-on testing: warmth and specs are the brands' own published figures.
